source: 01.10.2026 import: magazines, clips and speedloaders for the guns in the game
notes: Prologue rule (01.10.2026): a magazine is a loader, not a store. One that fits the gun, carried anywhere, makes the reload take firearms.json magazines.reloadFactor of the time, and one that holds more than the gun's stated capacity lets the gun hold that many.

firearms.json magazines.byGun is read from the CDDA magazine wells and speedloader lists; the whole-rifle AR lowers take the STANAG family. Ammunition belts are left out (the belt-fed guns state a 100-round capacity).
